fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2026-05-10 states that the complainant paid Rs. 3,50,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed, on 2026-04-30 at roughly 13:15. The online submission was made by Gunasekar Murugan (9000000210). The complaint refers to Udhay Muthu, a neighbour, reachable on 9000000352. A person named Madhan Babu, associated with the number 9000000490, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100044 as the destination of the transfer. The complainant mentioned social media screenshots and transaction records. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00371, as the mobile number 9000000490 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Advance processing fee allegedly collected for a loan that was not disbursed.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, mobile number, receiving account, suspect, residential colony, afternoon, associate
